newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power prices, volumes unchanged for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power prices, volumes unchanged for Wed.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left next-day price offers and volume limits unchanged from Monday, the agency said Tuesday.

Up to 500 megawatts (MW) of firm power was offered at $18.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) during light-load hours (0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST) for Wednesday delivery in the Northwest or the California-Oregon border (COB).
Sales of non-firm power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST were limited to 300 MW at $19.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
Another 300 MW of non-firm power for hours ending 0600 and 2300 PST was offered at $21.00 for both the Northwest and COB.
